reviews.text: The service was perfect from start to finish, both in terms of reception and veterinary consultation. The place was also clean and welcoming.
Very efficient vets. I've been there 4 or 5 times for my dog. No complaints whatsoever. Excellent care. I recommend them for veterinary emergencies.
A very positive experience, handled quickly. Thank you again.

We came on Sunday afternoon, October 4th, for our dog who had a severe cough and was vomiting.
We were very well received; the reception staff were very kind.
We had a long wait (about 2 hours), but that's normal when you come on a Sunday. It's also a walk-in emergency clinic, so it makes sense that emergencies take priority. :) Dr. Lenzi was very kind and gentle; he answered all our questions and took the time to speak with us.

The staff and caregivers were incredibly kind!

I highly recommend this urgent care clinic; they are very competent and don't push for unnecessary tests.
Top-notch staff: friendly, humane, and professional

Hello,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review of our veterinary clinic, Vétérinaires 2 Toute Urgence Marseille.

We are delighted to know that our veterinary care met your expectations. 🐶
Sincerely,
The V2TU Team

Thank you again to the entire team for the care and attention given to my cat during his hospitalization.
I can't thank Dr. Allemoz enough for keeping me regularly informed about my pet's health and the care he provided.
Thank you again from the bottom of my heart; I don't know what I would have done or what would have become of my beloved pet without your clinic.

I came in with my pet who passed away early this morning.
The young woman at reception was kind and welcoming.
She gave me time to say goodbye to my cat, wrapped in a blanket, as if she were asleep.
And she offered to take paw prints to keep as a keepsake.
The veterinarian took the time to come and see me and talk to me.
Thank you.

Excellent service, vet and reception staff were great. It's a shame about the waiting time, although I understand.

For the second time, the veterinarians at the V2TU clinic saved my cat, who was suffering from a very complex and serious double illness. They are attentive and very efficient. They took care to clearly explain the diagnosis and the treatment my cat received, and he was closely monitored throughout his hospitalization. I have complete confidence in them and I thank them.

Top-notch team 👌
From reception to the vet,
everyone is fantastic 👌
Dr. Verne is truly professional and very kind, taking the time to explain everything and the future care your pet will need.
The report provided by the clinic is extremely thorough and precise.
In short, I highly recommend this emergency center for your pet.

From the receptionist to Dr. Verne, my pet and I received exemplary care. Thank you!
The reception was satisfactory, the staff were attentive, and the veterinarians were very good.
Highly competent staff, from reception to the veterinarian. I recommend them!

A caring and attentive team whose professional dedication ensured our pet received prompt and effective care. We are extremely grateful to the entire team for the excellent care they provided our dog.

A huge thank you to the reception team and Dr. Morlon who welcomed my dog ​​and me. Dr. Morlon is incredibly gentle with animals, very professional, and kind. She quickly reassured me and was able to diagnose the problem very quickly thanks to her expertise.
Thank you again, Doctor.

A huge thank you to the entire team for taking such good care of my cat, Cooky.

The reception was excellent. Thank you to the person who was there. Dr. Lila Bigot took care of Cooky with attention, professionalism, and empathy. A special thank you for the idea of ​​the post-operative bodysuit, which meant he didn't have to wear the Elizabethan collar, which he had a hard time accepting.

Very best regards.
Hello everyone, here's a photo of me in my bodysuit, which makes me feel as strong as a tiger.

Arriving in an emergency, we were extremely well received despite the number of people already there; our dog was quickly taken care of; the diagnosis was rapid and the explanations given to us beforehand were clear and precise; the follow-up was also excellent! I highly recommend this establishment for any emergency situation.
